description: This header file defines the `absl::FunctionRef` type, a lightweight, non-owning reference wrapper for invokable objects with a specific signature. It provides mechanisms to construct from various invokable types, including function pointers and functors, and emphasizes usage as an argument type to avoid lifetime issues. The class is designed for efficiency, avoiding allocations and deep copies, and is suitable for use cases like visitor patterns and callback interfaces.

classes.name: absl::FunctionRef<R(Args...)>
classes.description: A lightweight, non-owning wrapper for any invokable object with a compatible signature, intended primarily for use as an argument type to avoid ownership and lifetime issues.

methods.name: FunctionRef(const F& f)
methods.description: Constructs a FunctionRef from any invokable type, ensuring compatibility with the signature.

methods.name: FunctionRef(F* f)
methods.description: Constructs a FunctionRef from a function pointer, optimizing storage and invocation.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the wrapped invokable object with provided arguments.
